name: Motion
tagline: AI productivity superapp: auto-scheduling, projects, and meeting notes.
description: Motion combines task management, project planning, and calendar scheduling, automatically time-blocking your day from tasks, deadlines, and workload and re-planning as priorities shift. It also generates project plans from a description and takes AI meeting notes with action items, integrating with Gmail, Outlook, Zoom, Slack, and more.
insight: Its core trick is auto-scheduling — it continuously rebuilds your calendar from your task list, so slipped work re-flows automatically.

modelSupport.notes: Uses LLMs for project generation, meeting notes, and search; underlying models not published.

edge: Auto-scheduling is the core: it continuously rebuilds your calendar from your task list so slipped work re-flows itself.
pros: Tasks, projects, calendar in one app
AI meeting notes with action items
